events.title: Major Update: The Mother Ship Grows, the Community Goal & 30 Languages
events.summary: Hello pilots! This is the biggest ECHIDNA demo update so far, and it lands right before Steam Next Fest (October 19). Since the last patch the mother ship has grown new stations, carcasses fight back with surprises, every run has more to chase, and the whole game is now in 30 languages. Here is everything that changed. Community Goal: strip together, unlock togetherEvery carcass every player strips now counts toward one shared number. events.title: Demo Update: Accessibility & Balance
events.summary: AccessibilityMouse-only mode. The ship now rides the ring under your cursor, and the middle button covers dash / docking / closing a console. Toggle it in Settings → Gameplay. Keyboard aiming and firing. The arrow keys aim and pull the trigger, and the right hardpoint finally has a key of its own (E, rebindable). The second weapon you bought is no longer mouse-only.
